notes: Bay Area Reporter, 4 January 1996 to 25 December 1997, 104 weekly issues, read from the Internet Archive's DjVu text (no hOCR). Hand-curated: address clusters and event-word passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, managers, staff, performers or patrons.

coverage.remaining: 1998 to 2005 remain: 396 issues in the collection, January 1998 to 28 July 2005.
coverage.note: 104 issues; 17,283 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 714 windows after the advertisement filter (454 of them rescued for an event word) in 633 address clusters, of which 323 hold an event word; the tighter filter left 98, all read; plus 857 event-word passages, of which the 29 with a fire, closing, lost-lease or moving word and no out-of-town or review marker were read. 28 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 26 resolved and published on 25 pages, none seeded; 3 of them placed by hand where EAS no longer holds the number (2789 24th Street on the York Theatre's parcel, 1101 Bush Street on the corner lot at 1105, and 3555 16th Street on the Eureka Valley Branch Library's place page). 1 held (1580 Mission, on a parcel with no page). 1 unresolved (74 Otis).
